fact: UNCTAD's ASYCUDA Programme reports that STP Customs completed migration to ASYCUDAWorld 4.4, live on 1 May 2025, replacing ASYCUDAWorld 4.2 in use since 2011.

The General Customs Authority (AGA) officially launched Sydonia World 4.4.0 on 23 May 2025, a customs management system implemented simultaneously across the national territory, financed by the AfDB under the CAPEM project with UNCTAD technical support.
